plans.idea: Editorial top-down stack: centered logo, full-width headline and subhead, then the glow image and the bottle side by side as one product band, with the CTA centered underneath to close the reading order.

Left-aligned split column: logo, headline and subhead run down a shared left edge, then the bottle sits above the CTA in a left column while the big glow image fills the lower right, the way the original pairs copy on the left with product on the right.

Image-led poster: logo over a large centered glow image at the top, headline and subhead below it on a wide measure, and a closing row at the bottom with the CTA on the left and the bottle on the right.
